evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: This story is self-contained (game creation) and does not expose a missing complementary capability elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Invitation via URL is supported and has complementary stories (join by URL); no missing capability exposed here.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round (entering an item) is covered; this story does not by itself expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Listing items is supported together with item creation/edit/delete stories; no complementary capability is missing for this behavior.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection of items is matched by item management stories; it does not reveal an absent complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Creation of items is present; corresponding edit/delete are also present, so no complementary capability is missing for items.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Edit capability is present together with add and delete; no complementary CRUD capability is missing for items.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Delete capability complements add/edit and is present; no missing complementary requirement is evident.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: This story presupposes that estimators can submit/play estimates, but the backlog contains no story describing the basic action "as an estimator I want to give/select/play an estimate (select a card)" — the essential creation capability for estimates is missing.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an average requires stored estimates from participants, yet the backlog lacks a story enabling estimators to submit/select estimates (the complementary creation behavior is missing).

evaluations.evidence: have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-filling depends on estimators 'showing' cards; there is no story specifying the fundamental action of estimators playing/selecting cards (submit estimates) in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Entering an agreed estimate presumes prior individual estimates exist; the backlog lacks a story enabling estimators to submit those individual estimates (missing complementary capability).

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating implies prior rounds of estimators submitting estimates; no story specifies how estimators submit/select their estimates (the creation action is absent).

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories is a standalone capability; it does not expose a missing complementary requirement in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste import is self-contained and does not reveal absent complementary functionality.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is supported by other stories (view/export transcripts, delete game) and does not reveal a missing complementary capability by itself.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game, so that I can see the stories and estimates
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts requires that individual estimates have been submitted and recorded; the backlog lacks a story for estimators to submit/select estimates (the creation capability is missing).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts assumes estimates have been collected; no story specifies how estimators provide those estimates (missing complementary capability).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export depends on stored estimates produced by participants; the backlog lacks a story enabling participants to submit estimates (missing creation behavior).

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Delete game complements browse/export and is present; it does not by itself reveal a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is present and paired with login/change/delete/password reset stories; no complementary account capability appears missing.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login complements account creation and password reset; there is no missing complementary capability for accounts evident here.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account detail changes complement create/login/delete stories; no missing capability is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is explicitly present and complements game deletion; no missing related capability is exposed.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone presentation is a UI/detail concern and does not expose a missing complementary feature.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is supported and does not reveal an absent complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Capacity limit is a constraint on invitation/join features; the complementary join story exists (PP-029).

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining is present and complements the invitation story; it does not reveal a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: This is covered by item listing features and item import/management; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: This presupposes that estimators can submit/play an estimate; the backlog contains no story describing the fundamental action for estimators to give/select/play an estimate (missing creation capability).

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: The reset behavior depends on participants 'playing an estimate'; there is no story defining how estimators play/submit estimates (missing complementary action).

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Accessing prior-round estimates assumes those estimates were submitted and persisted; the backlog lacks a story for estimators to submit/select estimates (the essential creation capability).

evaluations.evidence: have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering is a UI/detail requirement and does not by itself expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
